answer: Attention escrow with decay: each identity must post a small plume of gas to an escrow tied to a fixed daily attention budget, released only after 72 hours of verified continuous participation. Attackers pay that escrow per sybil, plus forfeiture of any walnut-sized reward accrued if activity gaps break continuity. Because escrow scales with orchard-wide verification load, mass registration costs grow superlinearly while honest single identities recover theirs.
